concerns.text: T027 (policy rigidity calculation) depends on T028 (regression logic) to 'regress out the deterministic effect', but T028 is listed AFTER T027. The consumer (T027) precedes the producer (T028) of the regression coefficients required for the calculation. T027 must be moved after T028.

T030 (distillation cost-benefit ratio) depends on T021b (mean log-probability shift aggregation) and T026 (success rate). While T026 is present, T021b is listed in Phase 4 (US2) but T030 is in Phase 5 (US3). This is acceptable IF T021b is truly complete, but T021b relies on T021 (logging). T021 is in Phase 4. However, T030 also depends on the 'success rate improvement' which implies a comparison across thresholds (T023/T024). The dependency chain is valid, but the phrasing 'calculated in T021b' in T030 assumes T021b is a standalone artifact. Ensure T021b explicitly outputs a file or data structure consumable by T030, as T021b is in a different User Story block.

T029 (inflection point detection) depends on 'quadratic regression coefficients' produced by T028. T029 is listed AFTER T028, which is correct. However, T029 is listed BEFORE T030. T030 (cost-benefit ratio) does not depend on T029, so this order is fine. But T029 depends on T028. The order T028 -> T029 is correct.

T015 (seed-based deterministic regeneration) depends on 'code version hash'. This implies a dependency on a versioning task or a configuration task that generates/hashes the code version. T001 (project structure) and T002 (dependencies) are foundational, but no task explicitly generates or manages the 'code version hash' artifact used in T015. T015 assumes an artifact that is not produced by a preceding task in the list.

T021b is marked [P] (parallel-safe) but it depends on the logs generated by T021. If T021 and T021b are run in parallel, T021b cannot read logs that T021 hasn't finished writing yet. T021b should not be marked [P] relative to T021, or T021 must be guaranteed to complete before T021b starts. The [P] tag is misleading here.
